issues.message: Wire routing between the relay board and the rest of the electronics cannot be traced from the photo.
issues.next_action: Sketch or photograph the wiring so each relay terminal's load is known.

issues.message: 4 wheel(s) are visible but no drive motor count is established. Wheels do not imply one motor each: the drivetrain layout (2WD, 4WD, skid-steer, free-rolling wheels) is unknown.
issues.next_action: Photograph the underside, then confirm the motor line in review with its required_quantity and type.

issues.message: A relay board is visible but no motor driver. Relay boards are not interchangeable with motor drivers: relays only switch on/off (no PWM speed control) and need an H-bridge arrangement to reverse direction.
issues.next_action: Check the intended motor control method (on/off relays vs. a PWM motor driver) before buying either.
